columns: What a good sign looks like
rows: Does the daily work match how your child naturally works and thinks?
Your child can describe a normal Tuesday in that role without dread.
Can the family fund this path without a loan the child cannot realistically repay?
The plan survives a bad-case scenario, not only the best case.
Do real employers, clients, or exams currently reward this skill?
Internships, entry roles, or apprenticeships genuinely exist for it.
Does the role still need judgment, trust, or hands-on skill that AI cannot fully replace?
Your child can name what a human still does better than a tool in that field.

items.heading: One Core Skill That Matches
items.text: One core skill that matches the target field, built with enough depth to be usable, not just a certificate.

items.heading: One Multiplier Skill on Top,
items.text: One multiplier skill on top, communication, basic data or AI-tool fluency, or business sense, that makes the core skill more valuable.

items.heading: Visible Proof of Work
items.text: Visible proof of work: a project, a portfolio piece, an internship result, or a small paid task a stranger can actually see.

items.heading: Market Positioning
items.text: Market positioning: knowing which employers or clients actually pay for this skill combination, not guessing.
